notes.shape: A restated cap with a link to the owning page and a fetch date beside it, and no statement of what obliges a recheck. Two of the record's four parts are present.
notes.carve_outs: Conforming pointer or record does NOT apply, and that is the point of the case. A link beside a stated value cites the value and does not record what obliges a recheck, and a dated sentence with no observable trigger is missing a part.
notes.rubric: R1 holds: the product owns the cap. R2 holds: a character count. R3 holds: stated as the current limit and used as the basis for a structural rule. R4 holds: a basis and an as-of date are present and the recheck trigger is absent, so the record is not whole.
notes.carries: The hardest positive in the restated-fact set, and the one most likely to be cleared on the strength of the link and the date. A run that clears it has accepted a partial record as a whole one.
notes.tier_reason: A source was supplied, so source-fetched-similar. Report-only.
